capabilities: Build and level up 5e characters with a step-by-step Builder
Roll skills, saves, attacks and damage by clicking sheet numbers
Manage spells, resources, inventory and companions including Wild Shape
Write monster, spell and item stat blocks in notes with computed numbers
Keep homebrew compendiums alongside the included SRD 5.1 and 5.2
disambiguation: Unrelated to other plugins named Archivist; it is a D&D character sheet, not a note-archiving or search tool.
extras: Freeware with closed source (reviewers can read it privately); the plugin makes no network requests while the companion web app handles campaigns, party view and an initiative tracker; first start unpacks about 3,600 read-only SRD notes into the vault; built with help from an AI coding assistant.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage D&D characters with automatic math, rollable dice, and monster stat blocks written in ordinary notes.

relations.evidence: Archivist rolls its dice with the free Dice Roller plugin (by Javalent).

summary: D&D 5e character sheet plugin that computes numbers from rules and homebrew, rolls dice on click, and renders stat blocks inside notes.
